correctness.rationale: Examined column-based proof: empty interior column forces both neighbors full; maximal chains of empties at distance two incur excess at least three. Without empties, two disjoint endpoint pairs each require one extra selected vertex, hence n+2 lower bound. Equality forces one double column in each end pair and singleton remainder; each internal singleton needs both missing labels horizontally, imposing rainbow triples and period three. Six permutations times two choices at each double boundary give 24 per one of four placement cases, hence 96, with valid constructive solutions. Independently implemented 8-mask-column dynamic program for n=7..100, matching (n+2,96) in every test.
